item.title: ‘Dare to Be Stupid: The Weird Al Musical’ Is Headed to Broadway
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard, your go-to source for the latest music news. I've got some exciting news for all you 'Weird Al' fans out there - he's headed to Broadway! That's right, a new jukebox musical featuring the Grammy Award-winning parodist's songs is in the works.
The musical, titled Dare to Be Stupid: The Weird Al Musical, will feature an original story written by Tony Award-nominated duo Scott Brown and Anthony King, along with 'Weird Al' himself. And if that's not enough, Tony winner Alex Timbers will be directing the show.
[Clip of "Weird Al" Yankovic's music plays]
Host: "The musical will feature tracks from 'Weird Al's' 40-plus-year career, including some of his most beloved parodies like 'Eat It', 'Amish Paradise', and 'Like a Surgeon'. As 'Weird Al' said in a press statement, 'The one thing people always say about Broadway is that it's "severely lacking in Weird Al-based entertainment," and I think this musical should fix that problem immediately.'
[Clip of Alex Timbers' quote plays]
Host: "Director Alex Timbers is a self-proclaimed 'Weird Al' fan and said, 'What Al, Anthony, and Scott are creating is unexpected, subversive, meta, and hilarious, and I couldn't wait for the world to experience it.' We can't wait to see what this musical has in store for us.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Stay tuned for more updates on Dare to Be Stupid: The Weird Al Musical, and don't forget to follow us for the latest music news and trends."
